mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot
  participant App
  participant BoardIO as STM32 board I/O
  participant Button as PA0 user button
  participant LED as PD12 indicator LED
  participant SysTick
  participant Logger
  participant Console as USART2 console
  Boot->>App: app_start
  App->>BoardIO: board_io_init
  App->>Console: console_init
  App->>Logger: LOGI bring-up started
  Logger->>Console: printf output via _write
  Console->>Console: Configure USART2 TX on PA2
  loop Foreground iterations; LED interval 200 ms
    SysTick-->>BoardIO: Increment millisecond counter
    App->>BoardIO: Read milliseconds and button state
    BoardIO->>Button: LL_GPIO_IsInputPinSet on PA0
    Button-->>BoardIO: Electrical input level
    alt 200 ms elapsed
      App->>BoardIO: board_io_led_toggle
      BoardIO->>LED: LL_GPIO_TogglePin on PD12
    else LED interval not elapsed
      App->>App: Keep LED state
    end
    alt Candidate button state changed
      App->>App: Record candidate and start debounce interval
    else Candidate unchanged
      alt Candidate stable for 20 ms and differs from stable state
        App->>Logger: LOGI pressed or released
        Logger->>Console: printf output via _write
      else Debounce interval not satisfied
        App->>App: Keep stable button state
      end
    end
    App->>BoardIO: board_io_wait_for_interrupt
  end
title: Sequence Diagram
